health.disk_low: Disk space is low: {{free, bytes}} free, {{minimum, bytes}} wanted.
health.sec_contact_missing: SEC updates are on, but no SEC contact (name and e-mail) is set, so nothing is fetched from SEC.
health.sec_poll_failing: Latest SEC filings: the last {{count}} checks failed ({{reason}}).
health.sec_poll_stale: Latest SEC filings have not been checked since {{time, et}}.
health.source_cooldown: {{source}} asked us to wait; requests resume at {{until, et}}.
health.worker_offline: The background worker is not running; nothing is fetched or computed.
system.collection_scope: Latest data first; Insider history defaults to {{months}} months (adjustable); each source can be paused separately
system.database_state_failed: Reading the database state timed out or failed
ui.sec_contact.description: SEC asks automated tools to identify themselves with a name and a real e-mail (the User-Agent). This contact is stored only in this computer's database and identifies requests to SEC and government disclosure websites.
ui.sec_contact.from_config: Set in the config file (IIRP_SEC_USER_AGENT in deploy/.env). To change it, edit that file and run ./iirp restart.
ui.sec_contact.name: Name or organization
ui.sec_contact.saved: Saved. SEC updates start within a minute.
ui.sec_contact.title: SEC contact
ui.system.title: System status
ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.settings.description: Saved on this computer; every browser that opens IIRP here uses them.
ui.settings.colors.title: Up and down colors
ui.settings.colors.hint: Used for prices, buys and sells, charts and heatmaps. Changes always keep their + or − sign.
ui.settings.colors.low_contrast: {{side}}: contrast {{ratio}}:1 on cards is below {{minimum}}:1, so text in this color may be hard to read.
ui.settings.strip.title: Home market strip
ui.settings.strip.hint: Unchecked instruments are neither shown nor fetched. Index futures appear only outside US stock hours, while they trade.
long_prices.gaps: Daily history has {{count}} missing completed sessions
ui.long_prices.title: Long-term price data
ui.long_prices.hint: S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 members, sector and industry ETFs, and benchmarks. Kept for the past {{years}} complete years, from January 1; updated after the close. Automatic updates follow the market switch in Data & tasks.
ui.long_prices.confirm_delete: {{action}}? The backfill starting date advances with this deletion. Older data will only be downloaded again if you choose Refill.
ui.long_prices.confirm_refill: Restore the backfill starting date to January 1, {{years}} complete years back? Missing history will be downloaded again through the normal rate-limited queue.
ui.long_prices.queued: Operation queued; progress is available in Data & tasks.
ui.watchlist.settings.title: Watchlist
ui.watchlist.settings.rule: Kept in this computer's database and in every weekly backup, the same in every browser. Adding, importing and filtering read local data only and never go online; a code without local data is kept and fills in once its filings or prices are collected.
ui.watchlist.settings.import_hint: Separate codes with commas, spaces or new lines
ui.watchlist.settings.import_nothing: No codes found in the text
ui.watchlist.settings.empty: No watched stocks yet. Click ☆ beside the title of a company page or a quote page, or paste a list above.
ui.settings.notable.title: Followed people
ui.settings.notable.rule: Kept in this computer's database and in every weekly backup. Add people with ☆ on their pages, the timeline and search results.
ui.settings.notable.rule_more: The default list (config/notable-people.toml) filled the list once. Your additions and removals are kept; restoring adds back the default people you removed and keeps everyone you added.
ui.settings.notable.restore_none: Everyone in the default list is followed
ui.settings.notable.empty: You follow no one. Restore the default list, or click ☆ beside a person.
ui.settings.notifications.title: Notifications
ui.settings.notifications.rule: Notified once each: a new filing or report of someone you follow, and rule matches. Nothing from before notifications were turned on, or before a person was followed.
ui.settings.notifications.rule_more: SEC filings count when the SEC accepts them; House and OGE reports when all their pages have been read. Sales say whether they were under a 10b5-1 plan. An amended filing or report is marked as an amendment and is not counted again. The bell keeps the list; desktop and phone notifications are optional.
ui.settings.notifications.rules_note: SEC open-market purchases only, by anyone, not just people you follow; counted as on the Insider overview.
ui.settings.notifications.executive_befo: A CEO or CFO buys at least $
ui.settings.notifications.executive_labe: Minimum CEO or CFO purchase, in dollars
ui.settings.notifications.cluster_after: or more people buy one company
ui.settings.notifications.desktop_note: This browser only, and only while an IIRP page is open (it may be in the background). Turning it on asks the browser for permission.
ui.settings.notifications.desktop_denied: The browser refused notifications for this site; allow them in the browser's site settings, then turn this on again.
ui.settings.notifications.desktop_unsupp: This browser cannot show desktop notifications.
ui.settings.notifications.phone_note: Sends public facts only (who, which stock, buy or sell, amount, trade and publication dates, and the public link of the original) to {{server}}. Anyone who knows the topic can read it, so keep it private.
ui.settings.notifications.regenerate_not: Phones subscribed to the current topic stop receiving; subscribe them to the new one.
ui.settings.notifications.subscribe_titl: How to subscribe on a phone
ui.settings.notifications.subscribe_1: Install the ntfy app (App Store, Google Play or F-Droid).
ui.settings.notifications.subscribe_2: Tap + (subscribe to topic), paste the topic above; for a server other than ntfy.sh, choose "use another server" and enter {{server}}.
ui.settings.notifications.subscribe_3: Send a test notification below; it should arrive within a few seconds.
ui.settings.notifications.privacy: To run your own server instead, install ntfy (for example with its Docker image), enter its address above and subscribe the app to that server.
ui.settings.notifications.last_sent: Last {{kind}} delivered to the server at {{time}}
